entities.name: Mundungu
entities.description: A group of mages of the Shaper Guild and the Shadow Guild of Zhalfir on Dominaria who built the tombs of Aku.

entities.name: Aku
entities.description: City built by the Mundungu in the Uuserk Marshes to hold the pillar tombs of Zhalfirin royalty.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Enemy whose demons the Mundungu kept away from Aku during the Mirage War.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: War during which the Mundungu kept Kaervek's demons from Aku.

events.summary: The Mundungu built the tombs of Aku.
events.quote: The Mundungu built the tombs of Aku

events.summary: The Mundungu and their djinn kept Kaervek's demons from Aku and were instrumental to his defeat.

relations.note: Kept his demons away and helped defeat him
relations.quote: kept the demons of Kaervek away from it during the Mirage War
